item.title: dotnet: Microsoft is updating its author-signing certificate starting September 23, 2026
item.description:
Microsoft will update the author-signing certificate used for NuGet packages on September 23, 2026. Users who rely on trusted signer policies or certificate fingerprint verification should add the new certificate before then.

  • Source: .NET

item.title: github: Manage the code coverage ruleset condition with the REST API
item.description:
GitHub now supports managing the “Restrict code coverage” repository ruleset option through the generally available REST API, in addition to the existing UI. This lets admins enforce code coverage requirements programmatically.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: azure: Announcing: Azure Copilot introduces direct access to agents
item.description:
Starting in August 2026, Azure Copilot will let customers interact directly with agents to move from questions to actions faster. Users can choose the agent best suited to their goal.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: github: Repository-level GitHub Copilot usage metrics generally available
item.description:
GitHub Copilot usage metrics REST API now includes repository-level activity. Two new endpoints provide a daily per-repository breakdown of pull request activity for Copilot coding agent and Copilot code review.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Set AI credit session limits in Copilot CLI and SDK
item.description:
GitHub Copilot CLI and the GitHub Copilot SDK now support AI credit session limits, letting you cap how much an agent can spend in a single session. This is intended to help control usage during longer-running agent workflows.

  • Source: GitHub
